description: This file defines the VacancyService class in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, responsible for managing vacancy-related operations via a DAO (Data Access Object). It includes methods to retrieve or instantiate the VacancyDao object.

classes.name: VacancyService
classes.description: Service class providing access to vacancy data via VacancyDao.

methods.name: getVacancyDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of VacancyDao, creating it if it does not exist yet.
